newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal sees China smelter start-up in June.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal sees China smelter start-up in June.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co said on Friday that the 100,000-tonne-per-year Jinlong copper smelter in China's Anhui province was due to begin operation around June, three months later than previously planned.

A Sumitomo spokesman cited no specific reason for the schedule change, adding that the furnace had just recently been ignited. He said it was not yet clear when the facility would reach full production.
In early January, a Sumitomo spokesman said the smelter was due to start on February 28.
Sumitomo owns a 20 percent stake in the project.
